plan.title: Counter Offer Acceptance Updates Bid Price

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ on the buyer's Responses tab, which is the required starting state.
Open Master QCS before sending the counter offer, as required by the counter-offer flow.

args.remark: Please revise pricing for bulk approval

steps.note: Send the buyer's lower counter price and required remark to the vendor.
Verify that the buyer's grid marks the vendor's bid as having a counter offer initiated.
Have the invited vendor accept the pending counter offer in the supplier portal.
Verify on the buyer side that the vendor's counter offer is marked accepted.
Return to the Responses tab to verify the accepted bid value there.
Assert that the Responses view shows the accepted bid price of 90 held for this prepared event.
Return to Master QCS to verify the accepted price and ranking.
Assert that the vendor's Master QCS rate is updated to 90.
Verify that Master QCS ranking follows the RFQ amount after the accepted price update.
